reason: application/booking.py imports sqlite3 and opens a SQLite connection inside BookingService.book, so SQL is used outside the SQLite adapter.
OutboxNotifier.send takes an extra required priority parameter, so it no longer satisfies the Notifier port and ReminderService's three-argument call would fail.
api/handlers.py imports the domain Slot and constructs it directly in book, so the request handler talks to the domain instead of only to the application.
The only change is a defaultdict-based event bus, which keeps the same subscribe, unsubscribe and publish behaviour and dependencies.
run_for is restructured to count active appointments first, still sending every reminder through the injected notifier and using only Appointment's public property and the store port.
